title: Evening Flock — Set one ring moving while its neighbor rests or follows slowly
help: The same eighty places start with different tangent flights. One ring can rest while the other moves, or follow the same direction at a quarter of its speed. Starting replaces the sky and clears beat history; these are starting velocities, not promised paths.
rows: Resting left ring, moving right ring
Moving left ring, resting right ring
message: unequal ring flights retain eighty places and begin as one paused sky
